case: placeholder-only identifiers are treated as safe
source_message: Questions? Call the program office at [PHONE] or email [EMAIL]. The program coordinator is [PROGRAM COORDINATOR]. Registered families only: your confirmation code is [FAMILY CODE].

expected.note: Bracketed placeholders are the correct convention. They must be preserved verbatim and must not be flagged as real personal data.

anti_pattern.note: This would be a privacy problem if committed or pasted into the tool.
anti_pattern.bad_example: Questions? Call Maria Ramirez at 555-0142 or email mramirez@example.org.
